name: scalvya
description: Scalvya — Vite frontend + Express API on Vercel (serverless)

scripts._comment_build: Deliberately NOT named 'build': Vercel auto-detects a build script, runs it, then fails looking for dist/. The app/ output is committed and served statically instead.
scripts._comment_e2e: Playwright runs LOCALLY (not in CI — CI stays lean by design). One-time setup: npx playwright install chromium
scripts._comment_e2e_auth: v11 SC-03: the signed-in matrix. Needs a NON-PRODUCTION Supabase project — see docs/RUNBOOK_AUTH_E2E.md. Not running it is a release blocker, not a pass.
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build:app && npm run check:app-fresh
scripts._comment_verify_prices: Read-only. Verifies what each Stripe price COSTS, not merely that its id is set. Run with the LIVE key before launch.
scripts._comment_add_eur: One-shot: adds EUR (currency_options) onto the SAME six live prices in place, so no new price ids / no Vercel changes. Run with the LIVE key, then verify-prices.
scripts._comment_audit: Production dependency advisories only (dev tooling is not shipped). Recorded for the launch gate; run before every candidate cut.
scripts._comment_launch: docs/launch/launch-state.json is the single release truth. `verify` checks the document is trustworthy (CI-safe, must stay green); `gate` recomputes GO/NO-GO and stays red until the evidence exists; `render` regenerates docs/LAUNCH_STATE.md.
scripts._comment_export_integrity: DOCX/PDF/ZIP structural validation and bounds — the export path that protects the paid deliverable.
scripts._comment_rehearsal: SC-04: validate a completed live-money rehearsal record against the canonical eight-transition matrix. Read-only; owner runs the rehearsal itself.
